from pathlib import Path
from app.report import contributions, total

issue = json.loads(Path(\"issue.json\").read_text())
rows = issue[\"rows\"]
actual = contributions(rows, issue[\"month\"], issue[\"deployed_config\"])
current = total(rows, issue[\"month\"], issue[\"deployed_config\"])
print(json.dumps({
    \"actual_contributions\": actual,
    \"actual_total_cents\": current,
    \"customer_claim_cents\": issue[\"customer_claim_cents\"],
    \"difference_cents\": current - issue[\"customer_claim_cents\"],
}, indent=2))
included_rows = [row for row, result in zip(rows, actual) if result[\"included\"]]
scenarios = {
    \"hypothesis_all_returns_reduce_sales_by_absolute_amount\": lambda row: -abs(row[\"amount_cents\"]) if row[\"kind\"] == \"RETURN\" else row[\"amount_cents\"],
    \"hypothesis_v1_signed_v2_return_magnitudes\": lambda row: -row[\"amount_cents\"] if row[\"kind\"] == \"RETURN\" and row[\"schema_version\"] == \"2\" else row[\"amount_cents\"],
}
for label, contribution in scenarios.items():
    print(json.dumps({\"hypothesis\": label, \"contributions\": {row[\"id\"]: contribution(row) for row in included_rows}, \"total_cents\": sum(contribution(row) for row in included_rows)}, indent=2))
'"
